scope: Inventory existing six-engine training-only isolated phrases, including original exact-zero PCM padding, without any detector score or feature/model change.
selection: All training rows with exactly these normalized ASCII word sequences, ignoring punctuation/case. Existing labels must agree; preserve source path, engine-qualified voice provenance and SHA aliases. No filtering by duration or score.
geometry: Use original v37/v39 150-frame conservative sample ledger: (e+d-150)*160 <= source_start; (e+d+1)*160 >= source_end. Compare full original WAV [0,N) to exact first/last nonzero PCM support, with the full960-sample RIR extension when specified. This is source-span geometry only, before actual frontend/crop/pack validation.
limits: Exact digital-zero support is not a phonetic boundary, a pronunciation review or a proposed relabel; all original WAV bytes stay intact.
No feature extraction or training eligibility is established by these counts: actual full-history raw geometry, labels, sampling and score equivalence would need a separately frozen experiment.
All sources are previously exported synthetic training material; correlated aliases/voices/conditions are not independent human trials or fresh acceptance.
No validation/new/final WAV, detector scoring, TTS generation, playback, microphone recording, device/firmware/settings change or production-board access.
